about: The field views of the fork riehlies/js_2d_fields (FORK.md there: src/fork/ is a separate layer on the original by Henrik Forstén, GPL-3.0). Not vendored: tools/fetch_fork.sh fetches this commit at build time and applies kisi's patches web/advanced/fork-patches/*.patch (README.md there: proposed for the fork; a pin that has taken one over drops it) for the 2D views of the field page kisi-advanced.html (tools/advanced_bundle.py, docs/reference.md "Field views"). third_party/js_2d_fields (the original, unmodified) is independent of it.
